title: Project quality is the main target driver
evidence: project_quality_score Spearman correlation with target is about 0.564, strongest single numeric feature.
next_step: Use as raw feature, test interactions with real_client_project_count, portfolio_score and technical_interview_score.

title: Role-specific skill fit improves tabular models
evidence: target_role is the strongest categorical feature; Cloud/MLOps/DevOps roles have higher mean target.
next_step: Create target_role specific weighted technical score features.

title: Mentor text contains usable signal
evidence: High target quartile uses terms like yuksek, basari, etkileyici, guclu more often; low target quartile uses practical-improvement terms more often.
next_step: Train TF-IDF Ridge model and blend with tabular predictions.

title: Missingness is informative
evidence: Internship duration, English score, GitHub stars, open-source contributions, HR interview and LinkedIn fields have structured missingness.
next_step: Add missing indicator columns and compare CV.

title: Year drift can break naive validation
evidence: application_year and graduation_year have visible train/test drift; test years are newer on average.
next_step: Track random KFold and year-based holdout scores.
